cities.name: Durane
cities.subtitle: L'Obelisque de Fer au bord du cratere
cities.description: Pierre grise, fer patine, passerelles et ateliers nains suspendus au-dessus de Canyonero.
cities.scene:
Reference 3 is the exact IRON OBELISK architectural silhouette to preserve: very tall narrow angular taper, straight central spire, stepped foot and restrained buttresses. Its sepia/gold is cartographic ink, NOT a requirement to make a golden palace. Reference 4 supplies the established Canyonero terraced mining setting, iron rails, braced bridges, cranes and mineral stone; do NOT copy its empty arena foreground or generic castle skyline.
DURANE: show the inhabited dwarf city along the upper lip of an enormous ancient oblique impact crater/canyon. The monumental Obelisk of dark aged IRON stands immediately against the rim, its base clearly on the edge above the abyss, not on an isolated island or far back in town. Pale gray monumental masonry and purposeful iron and copper bracing, compact angular towers, workshops, sturdy bridges across smaller fissures. Concentric excavated ledges and iron mine infrastructure descend inside the immense visible crater; trace of the long impact scar recedes into the far ash-gray and rust-red canyon landscape. Elevated three-quarter view from a nearby rocky approach, architecture in mid-ground, depth on the left/lower center, no huge empty plaza. Dry cool daylight gives readability, modest amber forge windows as accents. City intact and alive, dwarven engineering with subtly sophisticated functional joints, not stereotyped medieval castle, no airships or modern skyscrapers. No invented banners or oversized crystals.

cities.name: WoodLand
cities.subtitle: La terre des Cerelf
cities.description: Une cite entre arbres geants, arches vegetales ivoire, passerelles et cascades, a droite du lac en coeur.
cities.scene:
Reference 3 is the AUTHOR'S ARCHITECTURAL REFERENCE for WoodLand. Retain its giant living trees, flowing ivory-and-aged-gold organic arches, antler-like branching structural ribs, balconies, elegant connecting bridges, small turquoise crystal accents and cascades. Translate it into the bolder tactile painterly style of references 1/2; DO NOT copy its smooth photoreal rendering or accumulate uniform tiny ornaments.
WOODLAND, land of the Cerelf: an inhabited forest city organically built around several ancient giant trees on a stepped wooded valley. Distinct slender pale living-wood and ivory towers woven around trunks, interconnected bridges, water descending in several coherent waterfalls into a natural lake visible on the LEFT. From this raised three-quarter panorama the small lake reads as a gently organic HEART shape with two broad lobes and a narrowed bottom, not a perfect Valentine's symbol. Main city on the RIGHT beside it, as on the atlas. Subtle antler shapes in architecture, not generic European medieval roofs. Dappled warm afternoon sun, moss and varied green canopy, cool teal water and ivory buildings. Real scale, credible supports, clear bridge connections. Serene lush city, airy depth, no dominant giant crystal, no photo or glowing fantasy haze.

cities.name: Kalistopolis
cities.subtitle: Le sanctuaire des essences
cities.description: Une ile isolee portant le temple a haute fleche, avec un horizon marin ouvert.
cities.scene:
Reference 3 is the canonical landmark architecture ONLY, not the engraved sepia medium: preserve its tall slender straight faceted central spire, symmetrical angled buttresses, broad entrance and steps. Not a random multi-tower castle.
KALISTOPOLIS: isolated SMALL rocky island in the middle of the ocean, with this sacred essence sanctuary as its sole large building. Broad stone approach rising to the strong front entrance; pale weathered limestone, aged copper details and one restrained iridescent glass accent integrated into the spire, not a gigantic floating gemstone. Few small ancillary structures and a tiny landing establish a sanctuary, not a sprawling metropolis. Three-quarter coastal view from low cliff height, entire island footprint understandable, temple central and tall with generous sky. Calm daylight breaking through cloud, pearl sea with muted turquoise shallows, warm ivory on the sunlit temple and cool sea reflections. Distant continental shapes barely visible across an immense open horizon. Sense of neutrality and quiet importance, not ruins, not a golden cathedral copied from a real monument, no modern vessels or invented religious symbols.

cities.name: Arborium
cities.subtitle: La cite du dome
cities.description: Un grand dome nervure au coeur de la foret, desservi par des cours d'eau et de sobres chemins.
cities.scene:
Reference 3 supplies the AUTHOR-APPROVED DOME geometry: wide LOW hemispherical roof with fine curved ribs, modest pointed central finial, pointed front entrance and circular stepped footing. Preserve that recognizable silhouette; sepia drawing is not the color medium.
ARBORIUM: monumental botanical city dome nested in a clearing in the great western forest. Elegant aged warm wooden structural ribs with pale stone footings and translucent softly green-tinted glass panels, a wide dome enclosing visible tree silhouettes and gardens, not a giant treehouse, not a modern geodesic or sci-fi bubble. Small low timber/stone inhabited buildings and garden paths gather around its circular base, clear stream splits around roots and passes under an actual small bridge in foreground. Dense varied temperate forest surrounds it, a few enormous trunks frame one side without hiding the dome. View from a nearby forest slope, main dome fully in center with its canopy relationship clearly understood. Fresh early morning reflected daylight, forest greens, muted amber timber and pearl glass, gentle mist only far behind. Lived-in harmonious settlement, not ruined jungle temple, no giant crystals, no invented banners. Distinguish from WoodLand's tall pale tree towers: Arborium is the low ribbed dome and garden city.

cities.name: Velane
cities.subtitle: Le village de cabanes
cities.description: Un village humain chaleureux, cabanes modestes dans les arbres et passerelles de bois.
cities.scene:
Reference 3 is the canonical landmark concept: a broad living tree supporting a cozy timber cabin, not the sepia color palette.
VELANE: welcoming, mainly HUMAN tree-cabin village on the northwestern edge of the great forest, much more modest and practical than the Cerelf city WoodLand. Several sturdy uneven timber homes built around great deciduous trees, weathered plank roofs, small balconies, convincing supporting struts and rope/wood walkways. One central large tree and its warm cabin are the instantly readable landmark. Village is intact and cared for, not ramshackle ruins. A clear earth path and creek pass under the walkways; a few ground-level sheds, stacked firewood and small vegetable patch suggest daily life without clutter. Tiny distant human residents may establish scale, no close-up protagonist. Medium-wide view from a path entering the settlement, layered foliage, afternoon sunlight through leaves and a few warm window lights in shade. Rich moss green, warm weathered wood, soft gray stream and clean sky glimpses. No white elven palaces, no fairytale mushrooms, no decorative giant gems or modern technology.

cities.name: Vulkar
cities.subtitle: La cite du plateau du feu
cities.description: Architecture draconique de basalte, trois volcans, lac noir et quelques coulees de lave.
cities.scene:
Reference 3 establishes VULKAR's dark DRAX architectural world, ash-gray atmospheric painting, black basalt, horn-like noble palace doorway and restrained incandescent red seams. Do NOT include or copy the large dragon soldier; this is a city environment only.
VULKAR: intact noble inhabited dragon city atop an enormous elevated ash-covered basalt plateau. Three massive volcanic cones rise behind the city; one is active with a narrow vivid molten lava flow and plausible rising ash plume, two quieter cones. City sits BETWEEN the three peaks, not in their open magma craters. A noble basalt palace with abstract dragon-horn arches and strong stepped terraces anchors a compact city of angular black stone buildings. Narrow contained lava channels below rocky terraces, few glowing red architectural inlays and forge windows. Large calm BLACK lake in a depression at right reflecting one ember streak, visibly water not lava. Abrupt sheer basalt column cliffs fall from the plateau in the foreground, gray-black sea beyond, distant lower forest only far down at the foot. Three-quarter panoramic elevated view reveals height and the inhabited city. Diffuse ash daylight with cool silver/gray light keeps every major form legible; lava scarlet accents, not an entirely orange inferno or black silhouette. No flying dragons, no oversized foreground character, not a ruined Mordor clone.

cities.name: Cryptown
cities.subtitle: Le royaume des Skullz
cities.description: Une necropole en gradins dans un gouffre insulaire, croix monumentale et brouillard marin epais.
cities.scene: CRYPTOWN, the Skullz kingdom: a colossal inhabited cemetery-necropolis on and INSIDE the vast central dark pit of a rocky island. This is a kingdom of skeleton beings, no need to show a foreground character. Rings of worn gray funerary terraces, tombs, arched crypt doors and slender mausoleums descend into an immense chasm with no visible bottom. An unmistakable monumental ancient funerary CROSS rises from an inner terraced platform over the pit at the center, the recognizable atlas landmark. Stone stairways and narrow solid bridges physically connect the necropolis levels. A few tiny warm candle windows and subdued violet drapes within archways evoke Valazar's kingdom without copying him or inventing a flag. Broad thick cold sea FOG surrounds the island and extends over the nearby sea; mist strands seep down into the chasm, while the central cross and foreground tomb architecture remain readable. Elevated three-quarter view allows seeing the island coastline, pit rim, terraced city and depth. Storm-gray reflected light, cool charcoal stone, sparse warm candle accents, a little subdued violet. Tactile dark narrative painting matching Valazar, not a flat black hole, not ruined generic castle, no lava, glowing skull mountain, gore or giant character.

cities.subtitle: La cite sous-marine
cities.description: Une cite abritee dans une bulle au fond de la mer, au centre des recifs et de l'anneau d'iles.
cities.scene:
Reference 3 gives the approved CITY-IN-A-BUBBLE silhouette and architectural language: central ribbed spire and dome, a few slender side towers, arched entrances on a sea-floor base. Use its design in full-color PAINTING, not as a floating sepia emblem.
THALASSEA: a large complete transparent magical spherical bubble rests securely on the OCEAN FLOOR, protecting an inhabited elegant pale-stone sea kingdom, central ribbed palace dome and slender shell-inspired towers. The bubble has readable curved refraction, slight pearl rim, transparent surface and clean visible skyline, but is not glass with metal ribs. Dry enclosed streets and bridges inside, no human city standing in open water outside its protection. Wider environment truly UNDERWATER: layered coral and rock reef, sea grass, tiny schooling fish, slanting daylight filtering from the far surface. A circular arrangement of seafloor reef ridges around the city echoes the atlas ring of islands above, without putting floating islands inside the water or showing a cutaway diagram. Three-quarter wide underwater establishing view at moderate depth, whole bubble and supporting seabed readable. Muted turquoise/sea-green and deeper marine blues, pearl limestone, restrained warm interior windows, physically motivated water light, not neon aquarium and not an opaque glowing ball. Painterly brushwork and soft-edged water atmosphere, not CGI or photo.
